        if (missed == nullptr || apid > kMaxApid || seq > kSeqMask) return Status::BadArg;
        std::uint16_t* last = last_.find(apid);
        if (last == nullptr) {
            const Status s = last_.put(apid, seq);
            if (s != Status::Ok) return s;
            *missed = 0;
            return Status::Ok;
        }
        if (seq == *last) {
            *missed = 0;
            ++duplicates_;
            return Status::Duplicate;
        }
        *missed = static_cast<std::uint16_t>((seq - *last - 1) & kSeqMask);
        total_missed_ += *missed;
        *last = seq;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    std::uint32_t total_missed() const { return total_missed_; }
    std::uint32_t duplicates() const { return duplicates_; }

private:
    StaticMap<std::uint16_t, std::uint16_t, 32> last_;
    std::uint32_t total_missed_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t duplicates_ = 0;
};

// ---- Calibration: raw ADC counts to engineering units -----------------------
// Engineering values are whole numbers of milli-units (millivolts,
// millidegrees...), so every machine computes exactly the same bits.
struct Calibration {
    std::int32_t offset_milli;   // the value at raw 0
    std::int32_t gain_num;       // milli-units per count, as a fraction
    std::int32_t gain_den;
};

// value = offset + raw * num / den, in 64-bit, the division truncating
// toward zero. BadArg if den <= 0 or out is null; OutOfRange if the value
// does not fit in 32 bits (then *out is left alone).
Status calibrate(std::uint16_t raw, const Calibration& cal, std::int32_t* out) {
    if (out == nullptr || cal.gain_den <= 0) return Status::BadArg;
    const std::int64_t v = static_cast<std::int64_t>(cal.offset_milli) +
                           static_cast<std::int64_t>(raw) * cal.gain_num / cal.gain_den;
    if (v < INT32_MIN || v > INT32_MAX) return Status::OutOfRange;
    *out = static_cast<std::int32_t>(v);
    return Status::Ok;
}

// ---- Filters ----------------------------------------------------------------
// The mean of the last N values, kept as a running sum: O(1) a sample.
template <std::size_t N>
class MovingAverage {
public:
    // Adds v and returns the mean of the values in the window, truncated
    // toward zero. The window holds fewer than N values until N have come.
    std::int32_t push(std::int32_t v) {
        if (window_.full()) {
            std::int32_t oldest = 0;
            window_.pop(&oldest);
            sum_ -= oldest;
        }
        window_.push(v);
        sum_ += v;
        return static_cast<std::int32_t>(sum_ / static_cast<std::int64_t>(window_.size()));
    }
    std::size_t count() const { return window_.size(); }
    void reset() {
        window_.clear();
        sum_ = 0;
    }

private:
    RingBuffer<std::int32_t, N> window_;
    std::int64_t sum_ = 0;   // 64 bits: N values of up to 2^31 each cannot overflow it
};

// The median of the last three values: one wild sample never gets through.
class Median3 {
public:
    std::int32_t push(std::int32_t v) {
        a_ = b_;
        b_ = c_;
        c_ = v;
        if (seen_ < 3) ++seen_;
        if (seen_ < 3) return v;   // not enough history yet
        const std::int32_t lo = a_ < b_ ? a_ : b_;
        const std::int32_t hi = a_ < b_ ? b_ : a_;
        return c_ < lo ? lo : (c_ > hi ? hi : c_);
    }
    void reset() { a_ = b_ = c_ = 0; seen_ = 0; }

private:
    std::int32_t a_ = 0, b_ = 0, c_ = 0;   // oldest to newest
    int seen_ = 0;
};

// ---- A simulated sensor, with faults that can be injected -------------------
// A 12-bit ADC: raw values 0 to 4095. Noise comes from a seeded generator,
// so a run is the same every time.
constexpr std::uint16_t kAdcMax = 4095;

enum class SensorFault : std::uint8_t { None, Stuck, Bias, Spike, Dead };

class SimSensor {
public:
    Status configure(std::uint16_t base, std::uint16_t noise, std::uint32_t seed) {
        if (base > kAdcMax || noise > 512) return Status::BadArg;
        base_ = base;
        noise_ = noise;
        state_ = seed;
        fault_ = SensorFault::None;
        last_ = base;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    // The next raw sample.
    std::uint16_t read() {
        state_ = state_ * 1664525u + 1013904223u;   // a linear congruential generator
        const std::int32_t span = 2 * noise_ + 1;
        std::int32_t v = base_ + static_cast<std::int32_t>((state_ >> 16) % static_cast<std::uint32_t>(span)) - noise_;
        switch (fault_) {
            case SensorFault::None: break;
            case SensorFault::Stuck: return last_;   // frozen at the last good value
            case SensorFault::Bias: v += param_; break;
            case SensorFault::Spike:
                if (param_ > 0) {
                    --param_;
                    if (param_ == 0) fault_ = SensorFault::None;
                    return kAdcMax;
                }
                break;
            case SensorFault::Dead: return 0;
        }
        last_ = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(v < 0 ? 0 : (v > kAdcMax ? kAdcMax : v));
        return last_;
    }

    // Stuck: frozen at the last value read. Bias: adds param counts.
    // Spike: the next param samples read 4095. Dead: reads 0.
    Status inject(SensorFault f, std::int32_t param) {
        if (f == SensorFault::Spike && param <= 0) return Status::BadArg;
        fault_ = f;
        param_ = param;
        return Status::Ok;
    }
    void clear_fault() { fault_ = SensorFault::None; }
    SensorFault fault() const { return fault_; }
    void set_base(std::uint16_t base) { base_ = base > kAdcMax ? kAdcMax : base; }

private:
    std::int32_t base_ = 0;
    std::int32_t noise_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t state_ = 1;
    SensorFault fault_ = SensorFault::None;
    std::int32_t param_ = 0;
    std::uint16_t last_ = 0;
};

// ---- A sensor channel: read, calibrate, then filter -------------------------
struct SensorConfig {
    const char* name;
    std::uint16_t id;
    Calibration cal;
    std::uint16_t base_raw;
    std::uint16_t noise_raw;
    std::uint32_t seed;
};

class SensorChannel {
public:
    Status configure(const SensorConfig& cfg) {
        if (cfg.name == nullptr || cfg.cal.gain_den <= 0) return Status::BadArg;
        const Status s = sim_.configure(cfg.base_raw, cfg.noise_raw, cfg.seed);
        if (s != Status::Ok) return s;
        cfg_ = cfg;
        median_.reset();
        average_.reset();
        samples_ = 0;
        errors_ = 0;
        ready_ = true;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    // One sample: raw -> calibrated -> median of 3 -> mean of 8.
    Status sample(std::int32_t* filtered_out) {
        if (!ready_) return Status::NotReady;
        last_raw_ = sim_.read();
        std::int32_t v = 0;
        const Status s = calibrate(last_raw_, cfg_.cal, &v);
        if (s != Status::Ok) {
            ++errors_;
            return s;
        }
        last_value_ = v;
        filtered_ = average_.push(median_.push(v));
        ++samples_;
        if (filtered_out != nullptr) *filtered_out = filtered_;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    const char* name() const { return ready_ ? cfg_.name : "?"; }
    std::uint16_t id() const { return cfg_.id; }
    std::uint16_t last_raw() const { return last_raw_; }
    std::int32_t last_value() const { return last_value_; }
    std::int32_t filtered() const { return filtered_; }
    std::uint32_t samples() const { return samples_; }
    std::uint32_t errors() const { return errors_; }
    SimSensor& sim() { return sim_; }

private:
    SensorConfig cfg_ = {};
    SimSensor sim_;
    Median3 median_;
    MovingAverage<8> average_;
    std::uint16_t last_raw_ = 0;
    std::int32_t last_value_ = 0;
    std::int32_t filtered_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t samples_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t errors_ = 0;
    bool ready_ = false;
};

// ---- Events: what happened, when, and to what -------------------------------
// The flight side stores numbers only; the ground turns ids into words.
struct Event {
    std::uint32_t time_ms;
    std::uint16_t id;
    std::uint16_t source;   // the sensor, task or unit it is about
    std::int32_t value;
};

constexpr std::uint16_t kEvLimitNominal = 0x0101;
constexpr std::uint16_t kEvLimitYellow = 0x0102;
constexpr std::uint16_t kEvLimitRed = 0x0103;
constexpr std::uint16_t kEvSensorStuck = 0x0104;
constexpr std::uint16_t kEvSensorUnstuck = 0x0105;

// The newest 64 events. When full, the oldest is dropped: the latest
// history matters most, and logging must never fail or block.
class EventLog {
public:
    void record(std::uint32_t time_ms, std::uint16_t id, std::uint16_t source, std::int32_t value) {
        ring_.push_overwrite({time_ms, id, source, value});
        ++total_;
    }
    // The i-th oldest event still held.
    Status at(std::size_t i, Event* out) const { return ring_.at(i, out); }
    std::size_t size() const { return ring_.size(); }
    std::uint32_t total() const { return total_; }        // every event ever recorded
    std::uint32_t lost() const { return ring_.dropped(); }
    // How many held events have this id.
    std::size_t count(std::uint16_t id) const {
        std::size_t n = 0;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < ring_.size(); ++i) {
            Event e;
            if (ring_.at(i, &e) == Status::Ok && e.id == id) ++n;
        }
        return n;
    }

private:
    RingBuffer<Event, 64> ring_;
    std::uint32_t total_ = 0;
};

// ---- Limits -----------------------------------------------------------------
struct Limits {
    std::int32_t red_low;
    std::int32_t yellow_low;
    std::int32_t yellow_high;
    std::int32_t red_high;
};

bool limits_valid(const Limits& l) {
    return l.red_low <= l.yellow_low && l.yellow_low <= l.yellow_high && l.yellow_high <= l.red_high;
}

enum class LimitState : std::uint8_t { Nominal, YellowLow, YellowHigh, RedLow, RedHigh };

const char* limit_state_name(LimitState s) {
    switch (s) {
        case LimitState::Nominal: return "NOMINAL";
        case LimitState::YellowLow: return "YELLOW_LOW";
        case LimitState::YellowHigh: return "YELLOW_HIGH";
        case LimitState::RedLow: return "RED_LOW";
        case LimitState::RedHigh: return "RED_HIGH";
    }
    return "UNKNOWN";
}

// A value equal to a limit is still inside it.
LimitState classify(std::int32_t v, const Limits& l) {
    if (v < l.red_low) return LimitState::RedLow;
    if (v > l.red_high) return LimitState::RedHigh;
    if (v < l.yellow_low) return LimitState::YellowLow;
    if (v > l.yellow_high) return LimitState::YellowHigh;
    return LimitState::Nominal;
}

bool is_red(LimitState s) { return s == LimitState::RedLow || s == LimitState::RedHigh; }

// ---- A limit monitor with persistence ---------------------------------------
// One noisy sample must not raise an alarm, and one good sample must not
// clear it. Three run counters, each "samples in a row":
//   red_run      samples in red (either side)
//   yellow_run   samples outside yellow, red included
//   nominal_run  samples inside yellow
// After each sample the reported state becomes, in this order of priority:
//   red (the side of this sample)    if red_run     >= set_count
//   yellow (the side of this sample) if yellow_run  >= set_count
//   Nominal                          if nominal_run >= clear_count
//   otherwise it stays as it was.
class LimitMonitor {
public:
    Status configure(const Limits& l, std::uint8_t set_count, std::uint8_t clear_count) {
        if (!limits_valid(l) || set_count == 0 || clear_count == 0) return Status::BadArg;
        limits_ = l;
        set_count_ = set_count;
        clear_count_ = clear_count;
        red_run_ = yellow_run_ = nominal_run_ = 0;
        state_ = LimitState::Nominal;
        ready_ = true;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    // New limits from the ground: the runs start again, the state is kept.
    Status set_limits(const Limits& l) {
        if (!ready_) return Status::NotReady;
        if (!limits_valid(l)) return Status::BadArg;
        limits_ = l;
        red_run_ = yellow_run_ = nominal_run_ = 0;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    // Feeds one value. *changed says whether the reported state changed.
    Status update(std::int32_t value, bool* changed) {
        if (changed == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
        *changed = false;
        if (!ready_) return Status::NotReady;
        if (!enabled_) return Status::Ok;
        const LimitState raw = classify(value, limits_);
        red_run_ = is_red(raw) ? bump(red_run_) : 0;
        yellow_run_ = raw != LimitState::Nominal ? bump(yellow_run_) : 0;
        nominal_run_ = raw == LimitState::Nominal ? bump(nominal_run_) : 0;
        const bool high = value > limits_.yellow_high;
        LimitState next = state_;
        if (red_run_ >= set_count_) next = high ? LimitState::RedHigh : LimitState::RedLow;
        else if (yellow_run_ >= set_count_) next = high ? LimitState::YellowHigh : LimitState::YellowLow;
        else if (nominal_run_ >= clear_count_) next = LimitState::Nominal;
        if (next != state_) {
            state_ = next;
            *changed = true;
        }
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    // A disabled monitor ignores values and reports Nominal from then on.
    void enable(bool on) {
        enabled_ = on;
        if (!on) {
            state_ = LimitState::Nominal;
            red_run_ = yellow_run_ = nominal_run_ = 0;
        }
    }
    bool enabled() const { return enabled_; }
    LimitState state() const { return state_; }
    const Limits& limits() const { return limits_; }

private:
    static std::uint8_t bump(std::uint8_t n) { return n == 255 ? n : static_cast<std::uint8_t>(n + 1); }   // saturate

    Limits limits_ = {};
    std::uint8_t set_count_ = 1;
    std::uint8_t clear_count_ = 1;
    std::uint8_t red_run_ = 0;
    std::uint8_t yellow_run_ = 0;
    std::uint8_t nominal_run_ = 0;
    LimitState state_ = LimitState::Nominal;
    bool enabled_ = true;
    bool ready_ = false;
};

// ---- A stuck-sensor monitor -------------------------------------------------
// Real noise moves the last bits of an ADC all the time. The same raw value
// `window` times in a row means the sensor has frozen.
class StuckMonitor {
public:
    Status configure(std::uint16_t window) {
        if (window < 2) return Status::BadArg;
        window_ = window;
        run_ = 0;
        stuck_ = false;
        ready_ = true;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    // *became_stuck is true only on the sample that makes it stuck;
    // *came_back only on the first different value after that.
    Status update(std::uint16_t raw, bool* became_stuck, bool* came_back) {
        if (became_stuck == nullptr || came_back == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
        *became_stuck = false;
        *came_back = false;
        if (!ready_) return Status::NotReady;
        if (run_ > 0 && raw == last_) {
            if (run_ < window_) ++run_;
        } else {
            run_ = 1;
            if (stuck_) {
                stuck_ = false;
                *came_back = true;
            }
        }
        last_ = raw;
        if (!stuck_ && run_ >= window_) {
            stuck_ = true;
            *became_stuck = true;
        }
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    bool stuck() const { return stuck_; }

private:
    std::uint16_t window_ = 2;
    std::uint16_t run_ = 0;
    std::uint16_t last_ = 0;
    bool stuck_ = false;
    bool ready_ = false;
};

// ---- The cyclic executive ---------------------------------------------------
// Time is cut into minor frames of 100 ms (10 Hz); 10 minor frames make a
// major frame of 1 s, after which the pattern repeats. A task runs every
// `period` minor frames (1, 2, 5 or 10), in frames where
// tick % period == offset. Inside a frame, tasks run in rate-monotonic
// order: the shorter the period, the higher the priority; equal periods run
// in the order they were added.
constexpr std::uint32_t kMinorFrameUs = 100000;
constexpr std::uint8_t kFramesPerMajor = 10;
constexpr std::size_t kMaxTasks = 16;

constexpr std::uint16_t kEvFrameOverrun = 0x0201;
constexpr std::uint16_t kEvTaskOverrun = 0x0202;
constexpr std::uint16_t kEvTaskSkipped = 0x0203;

// A task does its work and returns the microseconds it used. In this
// simulation the number is the task's own report; on a real board the
// executive would read a hardware timer.
using TaskFn = std::uint32_t (*)(void* ctx, std::uint32_t tick);

struct TaskSpec {
    const char* name;
    TaskFn fn;
    void* ctx;
    std::uint8_t period;
    std::uint8_t offset;
    std::uint32_t budget_us;   // the most time it may take
    bool essential;            // still runs in safe mode
};

struct TaskStats {
    std::uint32_t runs;
    std::uint32_t skips;            // not started: its budget no longer fitted
    std::uint32_t budget_overruns;  // ran longer than its budget
    std::uint32_t max_us;
    bool enabled;
};

bool valid_period(std::uint8_t p) { return p == 1 || p == 2 || p == 5 || p == 10; }

class Scheduler {
public:
    void attach_log(EventLog* log) { log_ = log; }

    // Registers a task; *id gets its number (0, 1, 2 ... in the order added).
    Status add(const TaskSpec& t, std::uint8_t* id) {
        if (id == nullptr || t.name == nullptr || t.fn == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
        if (!valid_period(t.period) || t.offset >= t.period) return Status::BadArg;
        if (t.budget_us == 0 || t.budget_us > kMinorFrameUs) return Status::BadArg;
        if (built_) return Status::Forbidden;   // the schedule is fixed once built
        if (count_ == kMaxTasks) return Status::Full;
        tasks_[count_] = t;
        stats_[count_] = {0, 0, 0, 0, true};
        *id = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(count_);
        ++count_;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    // Builds the frame tables and proves them: in every minor frame, the
    // budgets of the tasks due must add up to at most kMinorFrameUs.
    // Overrun (and nothing built) if a frame is overbooked.
    Status build() {
        if (built_) return Status::Ok;
        // Priority order: a stable insertion sort of the ids by period.
        std::uint8_t order[kMaxTasks];
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count_; ++i) {
            std::size_t j = i;
            while (j > 0 && tasks_[order[j - 1]].period > tasks_[i].period) {
                order[j] = order[j - 1];
                --j;
            }
            order[j] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
        }
        std::uint8_t table[kFramesPerMajor][kMaxTasks];
        std::uint8_t lens[kFramesPerMajor] = {};
        for (std::uint8_t f = 0; f < kFramesPerMajor; ++f) {
            std::uint32_t booked = 0;
            for (std::size_t k = 0; k < count_; ++k) {
                const TaskSpec& t = tasks_[order[k]];
                if (f % t.period != t.offset) continue;
                booked += t.budget_us;
                table[f][lens[f]++] = order[k];
            }
            if (booked > kMinorFrameUs) return Status::Overrun;
        }
        std::memcpy(table_, table, sizeof table_);
        std::memcpy(lens_, lens, sizeof lens_);
        built_ = true;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    // Runs the tasks due in this minor frame, highest priority first.
    // Before starting a task, its whole budget must still fit in the frame;
    // if not, it is skipped this time. Returns Overrun if the frame used
    // more than kMinorFrameUs in the end, else Ok.
    Status run_frame() {
        if (!built_) return Status::NotReady;
        const std::uint8_t f = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(tick_ % kFramesPerMajor);
        const std::uint32_t now_ms = tick_ * (kMinorFrameUs / 1000);
        std::uint32_t used = 0;
        for (std::uint8_t k = 0; k < lens_[f]; ++k) {
            const std::uint8_t id = table_[f][k];
            const TaskSpec& t = tasks_[id];
            TaskStats& st = stats_[id];
            if (!st.enabled) continue;
            if (used + t.budget_us > kMinorFrameUs) {
                ++st.skips;
                if (log_ != nullptr) log_->record(now_ms, kEvTaskSkipped, id, static_cast<std::int32_t>(used));
                continue;
            }
            const std::uint32_t us = t.fn(t.ctx, tick_);
            ++st.runs;
            if (us > st.max_us) st.max_us = us;
            if (us > t.budget_us) {
                ++st.budget_overruns;
                if (log_ != nullptr) log_->record(now_ms, kEvTaskOverrun, id, static_cast<std::int32_t>(us));
            }
            used += us;
        }
        last_frame_us_ = used;
        ++tick_;
        if (used > kMinorFrameUs) {
            ++frame_overruns_;
            if (log_ != nullptr) log_->record(now_ms, kEvFrameOverrun, 0, static_cast<std::int32_t>(used));
            return Status::Overrun;
        }
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    Status set_enabled(std::uint8_t id, bool on) {
        if (id >= count_) return Status::NotFound;
        stats_[id].enabled = on;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    Status find(const char* name, std::uint8_t* id) const {
        if (name == nullptr || id == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count_; ++i) {
            if (std::strcmp(tasks_[i].name, name) == 0) {
                *id = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(i);
                return Status::Ok;
            }
        }
        return Status::NotFound;
    }

    // Safe mode: only essential tasks keep running.
    void shed_nonessential() {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count_; ++i) {
            if (!tasks_[i].essential) stats_[i].enabled = false;
        }
    }
    void enable_all() {
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count_; ++i) stats_[i].enabled = true;
    }

    // The ids due in minor frame f, in the order they run; returns how many.
    std::uint8_t frame_tasks(std::uint8_t f, std::uint8_t* ids, std::uint8_t max) const {
        if (!built_ || f >= kFramesPerMajor || ids == nullptr) return 0;
        std::uint8_t n = 0;
        for (std::uint8_t k = 0; k < lens_[f] && n < max; ++k) ids[n++] = table_[f][k];
        return n;
    }

    const TaskStats* stats(std::uint8_t id) const { return id < count_ ? &stats_[id] : nullptr; }
    const char* task_name(std::uint8_t id) const { return id < count_ ? tasks_[id].name : "?"; }
    std::size_t task_count() const { return count_; }
    std::uint32_t tick() const { return tick_; }
    std::uint32_t frame_overruns() const { return frame_overruns_; }
    std::uint32_t last_frame_us() const { return last_frame_us_; }
    bool built() const { return built_; }

private:
    TaskSpec tasks_[kMaxTasks] = {};
    TaskStats stats_[kMaxTasks] = {};
    std::size_t count_ = 0;
    std::uint8_t table_[kFramesPerMajor][kMaxTasks] = {};
    std::uint8_t lens_[kFramesPerMajor] = {};
    bool built_ = false;
    std::uint32_t tick_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t frame_overruns_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t last_frame_us_ = 0;
    EventLog* log_ = nullptr;
};

// ---- Modes ------------------------------------------------------------------
enum class Mode : std::uint8_t { Boot = 0, Nominal = 1, Safe = 2 };

const char* mode_name(Mode m) {
    switch (m) {
        case Mode::Boot: return "BOOT";
        case Mode::Nominal: return "NOMINAL";
        case Mode::Safe: return "SAFE";
    }
    return "UNKNOWN";
}

constexpr std::uint16_t kEvModeChange = 0x0301;

using ModeListener = void (*)(void* ctx, Mode from, Mode to);

// Legal moves: Boot -> Nominal, Boot -> Safe, Nominal -> Safe, Safe -> Nominal.
// Nothing goes back to Boot. Asking for the mode you are in is Ok and
// changes nothing.
class ModeManager {
public:
    void attach_log(EventLog* log) { log_ = log; }
    void listen(ModeListener fn, void* ctx) {
        listener_ = fn;
        listener_ctx_ = ctx;
    }

    Status request(Mode to, std::uint32_t now_ms) {
        if (to != Mode::Boot && to != Mode::Nominal && to != Mode::Safe) return Status::BadArg;
        if (to == mode_) return Status::Ok;
        if (to == Mode::Boot) return Status::Forbidden;
        const Mode from = mode_;
        mode_ = to;
        entered_ms_ = now_ms;
        ++transitions_;
        if (log_ != nullptr) log_->record(now_ms, kEvModeChange, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(from), static_cast<std::int32_t>(to));
        if (listener_ != nullptr) listener_(listener_ctx_, from, to);
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    Mode mode() const { return mode_; }
    std::uint32_t entered_ms() const { return entered_ms_; }
    std::uint32_t transitions() const { return transitions_; }

private:
    Mode mode_ = Mode::Boot;
    std::uint32_t entered_ms_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t transitions_ = 0;
    EventLog* log_ = nullptr;
    ModeListener listener_ = nullptr;
    void* listener_ctx_ = nullptr;
};

// ---- Commands ---------------------------------------------------------------
// A command is a Command-type packet to kCommandApid whose payload is one
// opcode byte followed by exactly that command's argument bytes.
constexpr std::uint16_t kCommandApid = 0x010;
constexpr std::uint16_t kAckApid = 0x011;
constexpr std::size_t kMaxCommands = 32;

constexpr std::uint16_t kEvCmdAccepted = 0x0302;
constexpr std::uint16_t kEvCmdRejected = 0x0303;
constexpr std::uint16_t kEvCmdFailed = 0x0304;

using CommandFn = Status (*)(void* ctx, ByteReader* args, std::uint32_t now_ms);

struct CommandDef {
    std::uint8_t opcode;
    const char* name;
    std::uint8_t arg_bytes;
    bool allowed_in_safe;
    CommandFn fn;
    void* ctx;
};

// What the ground hears back about one command.
struct Ack {
    std::uint16_t seq;      // the command packet's sequence count
    std::uint8_t opcode;    // 0 if it never got that far
    Status status;
};

class CommandHandler {
public:
    void attach(ModeManager* modes, EventLog* log) {
        modes_ = modes;
        log_ = log;
    }

    Status add(const CommandDef& def) {
        if (def.name == nullptr || def.fn == nullptr || def.arg_bytes > kMaxPayload - 1) return Status::BadArg;
        if (table_.contains(def.opcode)) return Status::Duplicate;
        return table_.put(def.opcode, def);
    }

    // Decodes, validates and runs one command, in this order:
    //   decode (its status) -> Command type (BadType) -> APID (UnknownApid)
    //   -> an opcode byte (BadArgs) -> known opcode (BadOpcode)
    //   -> exact argument length (BadArgs) -> allowed in this mode (Forbidden)
    //   -> run it. The ack always says how far it got.
    Status handle(const std::uint8_t* bytes, std::size_t len, std::uint32_t now_ms, Ack* ack) {
        if (bytes == nullptr || ack == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
        *ack = {0, 0, Status::Ok};
        Packet p;
        std::size_t used = 0;
        Status s = decode_packet(bytes, len, &p, &used);
        if (s == Status::Ok) {
            ack->seq = p.hdr.seq_count;
            if (p.hdr.type != PacketType::Command) s = Status::BadType;
            else if (p.hdr.apid != kCommandApid) s = Status::UnknownApid;
            else if (p.payload_len < 1) s = Status::BadArgs;
        }
        const CommandDef* def = nullptr;
        if (s == Status::Ok) {
            ack->opcode = p.payload[0];
            def = table_.find(p.payload[0]);
            if (def == nullptr) s = Status::BadOpcode;
            else if (p.payload_len - 1u != def->arg_bytes) s = Status::BadArgs;
            else if (modes_ != nullptr && modes_->mode() == Mode::Safe && !def->allowed_in_safe) s = Status::Forbidden;
        }
        if (s != Status::Ok) {
            ++rejected_;
            ack->status = s;
            if (log_ != nullptr) log_->record(now_ms, kEvCmdRejected, ack->opcode, static_cast<std::int32_t>(s));
            return s;
        }
        ++accepted_;
        ByteReader args(p.payload + 1, def->arg_bytes);
        s = def->fn(def->ctx, &args, now_ms);
        ack->status = s;
        if (s != Status::Ok) {
            ++failed_;
            if (log_ != nullptr) log_->record(now_ms, kEvCmdFailed, def->opcode, static_cast<std::int32_t>(s));
        } else if (log_ != nullptr) {
            log_->record(now_ms, kEvCmdAccepted, def->opcode, 0);
        }
        return s;
    }

    void reset_counters() { accepted_ = rejected_ = failed_ = 0; }
    std::uint32_t accepted() const { return accepted_; }   // passed every check
    std::uint32_t rejected() const { return rejected_; }   // failed a check
    std::uint32_t failed() const { return failed_; }       // accepted, but running it failed
    const CommandDef* lookup(std::uint8_t opcode) const { return table_.find(opcode); }

private:
    StaticMap<std::uint8_t, CommandDef, kMaxCommands> table_;
    ModeManager* modes_ = nullptr;
    EventLog* log_ = nullptr;
    std::uint32_t accepted_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t rejected_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t failed_ = 0;
};

// The ack packet's payload: seq (2 bytes), opcode, status code.
Status encode_ack(const Ack& ack, PacketEncoder* enc, std::uint32_t now_ms, std::uint8_t* out, std::size_t cap, std::size_t* written) {
    if (enc == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
    std::uint8_t payload[4];
    ByteWriter w(payload, sizeof payload);
    w.u16(ack.seq);
    w.u8(ack.opcode);
    w.u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(ack.status));
    return enc->build(PacketType::Telemetry, kAckApid, now_ms, payload, w.size(), out, cap, written);
}

// Ground side: a command packet with the given sequence count.
Status build_command(std::uint16_t seq, std::uint8_t opcode, const std::uint8_t* args, std::size_t n, std::uint32_t time_ms,
                     std::uint8_t* out, std::size_t cap, std::size_t* written) {
    if ((args == nullptr && n > 0) || n > kMaxPayload - 1 || seq > kSeqMask) return Status::BadArg;
    Packet p{};
    p.hdr = {0, PacketType::Command, true, kCommandApid, kSeqUnsegmented, seq, 0};
    p.time_ms = time_ms;
    p.payload[0] = opcode;
    if (n > 0) std::memcpy(p.payload + 1, args, n);
    p.payload_len = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(n + 1);
    return encode_packet(p, out, cap, written);
}

// ---- The standard commands ----------------------------------------------------
constexpr std::uint8_t kOpNoop = 0x01;
constexpr std::uint8_t kOpSetMode = 0x02;
constexpr std::uint8_t kOpResetCounters = 0x03;
constexpr std::uint8_t kOpSetLimits = 0x04;
constexpr std::uint8_t kOpEnableTask = 0x05;
constexpr std::uint8_t kOpDisableTask = 0x06;

Status cmd_noop(void*, ByteReader*, std::uint32_t) { return Status::Ok; }

// One byte: the mode wanted (0, 1 or 2). ctx: the ModeManager.
Status cmd_set_mode(void* ctx, ByteReader* args, std::uint32_t now_ms) {
    if (ctx == nullptr || args == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
    std::uint8_t m = 0;
    if (args->u8(&m) != Status::Ok) return Status::BadArgs;
    if (m > 2) return Status::BadArgs;
    return static_cast<ModeManager*>(ctx)->request(static_cast<Mode>(m), now_ms);
}

// No bytes. ctx: the CommandHandler whose counters go back to 0.
Status cmd_reset_counters(void* ctx, ByteReader*, std::uint32_t) {
    if (ctx == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
    static_cast<CommandHandler*>(ctx)->reset_counters();
    return Status::Ok;
}

// The monitors a SET_LIMITS command can reach.
struct MonitorBank {
    LimitMonitor* monitors;
    std::uint8_t count;
};

// 17 bytes: monitor index, then red_low, yellow_low, yellow_high, red_high
// as big-endian int32. ctx: a MonitorBank.
Status cmd_set_limits(void* ctx, ByteReader* args, std::uint32_t) {
    if (ctx == nullptr || args == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
    const MonitorBank* bank = static_cast<const MonitorBank*>(ctx);
    std::uint8_t which = 0;
    Limits l{};
    args->u8(&which);
    args->i32(&l.red_low);
    args->i32(&l.yellow_low);
    args->i32(&l.yellow_high);
    args->i32(&l.red_high);
    if (!args->ok()) return Status::BadArgs;
    if (which >= bank->count) return Status::NotFound;
    if (!limits_valid(l)) return Status::BadArgs;
    return bank->monitors[which].set_limits(l);
}

// One byte: the task id. ctx: the Scheduler.
Status cmd_enable_task(void* ctx, ByteReader* args, std::uint32_t) {
    if (ctx == nullptr || args == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
    std::uint8_t id = 0;
    if (args->u8(&id) != Status::Ok) return Status::BadArgs;
    return static_cast<Scheduler*>(ctx)->set_enabled(id, true);
}

Status cmd_disable_task(void* ctx, ByteReader* args, std::uint32_t) {
    if (ctx == nullptr || args == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
    std::uint8_t id = 0;
    if (args->u8(&id) != Status::Ok) return Status::BadArgs;
    return static_cast<Scheduler*>(ctx)->set_enabled(id, false);
}

// ---- Redundant sensors: a primary and a backup ------------------------------
// Isolation takes a failed unit out of use and switches to its partner.
class SensorPair {
public:
    Status configure(std::uint16_t primary, std::uint16_t backup) {
        if (primary == backup) return Status::BadArg;
        unit_[0] = primary;
        unit_[1] = backup;
        failed_[0] = failed_[1] = false;
        active_ = 0;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    // Marks unit failed. If it was the active one and its partner is still
    // good, switches to the partner. NotFound if the unit is not in this
    // pair; NoSpace if there is no good unit left to switch to.
    Status isolate(std::uint16_t unit) {
        int k = -1;
        if (unit == unit_[0]) k = 0;
        else if (unit == unit_[1]) k = 1;
        if (k < 0) return Status::NotFound;
        failed_[k] = true;
        if (k != active_) return Status::Ok;   // the spare failed: keep flying on the active one
        if (failed_[1 - k]) return Status::NoSpace;
        active_ = 1 - k;
        ++switches_;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    // Ground says a unit is good again.
    Status restore(std::uint16_t unit) {
        if (unit == unit_[0]) failed_[0] = false;
        else if (unit == unit_[1]) failed_[1] = false;
        else return Status::NotFound;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    std::uint16_t active() const { return unit_[active_]; }
    bool failed(std::uint16_t unit) const {
        return (unit == unit_[0] && failed_[0]) || (unit == unit_[1] && failed_[1]);
    }
    std::uint32_t switches() const { return switches_; }

private:
    std::uint16_t unit_[2] = {0, 1};
    bool failed_[2] = {false, false};
    int active_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t switches_ = 0;
};

// ---- Fault detection, isolation and recovery (FDIR) ---------------------------
enum class FaultId : std::uint8_t { SensorStuck = 0, LimitRed = 1, TaskOverrun = 2, FrameOverrun = 3, UplinkErrors = 4 };
constexpr std::size_t kFaultKinds = 5;

enum class Response : std::uint8_t { LogOnly, Isolate, Recover, SafeMode };

const char* response_name(Response r) {
    switch (r) {
        case Response::LogOnly: return "LOG";
        case Response::Isolate: return "ISOLATE";
        case Response::Recover: return "RECOVER";
        case Response::SafeMode: return "SAFE_MODE";
    }
    return "UNKNOWN";
}

// Respond with `first` for the first `budget` reports of this fault; after
// that, with `then`. A budget of 0 goes straight to `then`.
struct FaultRule {
    FaultId id;
    Response first;
    std::uint8_t budget;
    Response then;
};

constexpr std::uint16_t kEvFault = 0x0401;       // source: fault id, value: the unit
constexpr std::uint16_t kEvResponse = 0x0402;    // source: fault id, value: the response taken
constexpr std::uint16_t kEvEscalated = 0x0403;   // source: fault id, value: the response that failed

// The unit-specific actions, supplied by whoever owns the units.
struct FaultHooks {
    Status (*isolate)(void* ctx, FaultId id, std::uint16_t unit);
    Status (*recover)(void* ctx, FaultId id, std::uint16_t unit);
    void* ctx;
};

class FaultManager {
public:
    void attach(ModeManager* modes, EventLog* log, FaultHooks hooks) {
        modes_ = modes;
        log_ = log;
        hooks_ = hooks;
    }

    Status set_rule(const FaultRule& r) {
        const std::size_t k = static_cast<std::size_t>(r.id);
        if (k >= kFaultKinds) return Status::BadArg;
        rules_[k] = r;
        has_rule_[k] = true;
        used_[k] = 0;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    // A monitor confirmed fault id on unit. Picks the response by the rule
    // and its budget, carries it out and writes it to *taken. If an Isolate
    // or Recover action fails, escalates at once to safe mode.
    Status report(FaultId id, std::uint16_t unit, std::uint32_t now_ms, Response* taken) {
        const std::size_t k = static_cast<std::size_t>(id);
        if (k >= kFaultKinds || taken == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
        if (!has_rule_[k]) return Status::NotFound;
        ++count_[k];
        latched_ = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(latched_ | (1u << k));
        note(now_ms, kEvFault, id, unit);
        const FaultRule& r = rules_[k];
        Response resp = r.then;
        if (used_[k] < r.budget) {
            resp = r.first;
            ++used_[k];
        }
        Status s = act(resp, id, unit, now_ms);
        if (s != Status::Ok && resp != Response::SafeMode) {
            note(now_ms, kEvEscalated, id, static_cast<std::int32_t>(resp));
            resp = Response::SafeMode;
            s = act(resp, id, unit, now_ms);
        }
        note(now_ms, kEvResponse, id, static_cast<std::int32_t>(resp));
        *taken = resp;
        return s;
    }

    // Ground clears a fault: the latch goes and its budget starts again.
    Status clear(FaultId id) {
        const std::size_t k = static_cast<std::size_t>(id);
        if (k >= kFaultKinds) return Status::BadArg;
        latched_ = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(latched_ & ~(1u << k));
        used_[k] = 0;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    std::uint16_t latched() const { return latched_; }
    std::uint32_t count(FaultId id) const {
        const std::size_t k = static_cast<std::size_t>(id);
        return k < kFaultKinds ? count_[k] : 0;
    }
    std::uint32_t safe_entries() const { return safe_entries_; }

private:
    Status act(Response r, FaultId id, std::uint16_t unit, std::uint32_t now_ms) {
        switch (r) {
            case Response::LogOnly: return Status::Ok;
            case Response::Isolate:
                return hooks_.isolate == nullptr ? Status::NotImpl : hooks_.isolate(hooks_.ctx, id, unit);
            case Response::Recover:
                return hooks_.recover == nullptr ? Status::NotImpl : hooks_.recover(hooks_.ctx, id, unit);
            case Response::SafeMode:
                if (modes_ == nullptr) return Status::NotReady;
                if (modes_->mode() != Mode::Safe) ++safe_entries_;
                return modes_->request(Mode::Safe, now_ms);
        }
        return Status::BadArg;
    }
    void note(std::uint32_t now_ms, std::uint16_t ev, FaultId id, std::int32_t value) {
        if (log_ != nullptr) log_->record(now_ms, ev, static_cast<std::uint16_t>(id), value);
    }

    FaultRule rules_[kFaultKinds] = {};
    bool has_rule_[kFaultKinds] = {};
    std::uint8_t used_[kFaultKinds] = {};
    std::uint32_t count_[kFaultKinds] = {};
    std::uint16_t latched_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t safe_entries_ = 0;
    ModeManager* modes_ = nullptr;
    EventLog* log_ = nullptr;
    FaultHooks hooks_ = {nullptr, nullptr, nullptr};
};

// Ground command: CLEAR_FAULT, one byte (the fault id). ctx: the FaultManager.
constexpr std::uint8_t kOpClearFault = 0x07;
constexpr std::uint8_t kOpRestoreSensor = 0x08;

// Ground command: RESTORE_SENSOR, one byte (the unit). ctx: the SensorPair.
Status cmd_restore_sensor(void* ctx, ByteReader* args, std::uint32_t) {
    if (ctx == nullptr || args == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
    std::uint8_t unit = 0;
    if (args->u8(&unit) != Status::Ok) return Status::BadArgs;
    return static_cast<SensorPair*>(ctx)->restore(unit);
}

Status cmd_clear_fault(void* ctx, ByteReader* args, std::uint32_t) {
    if (ctx == nullptr || args == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
    std::uint8_t id = 0;
    if (args->u8(&id) != Status::Ok) return Status::BadArgs;
    if (id >= kFaultKinds) return Status::BadArgs;
    return static_cast<FaultManager*>(ctx)->clear(static_cast<FaultId>(id));
}

// ---- Housekeeping: the spacecraft's health, once a second -------------------
constexpr std::uint16_t kHkApid = 0x020;
constexpr std::size_t kHkSensors = 4;
constexpr std::size_t kHkBytes = 36;

struct HkReport {
    Mode mode;
    std::uint16_t faults_latched;   // bit k: FaultId k is latched
    std::uint32_t uptime_s;
    std::uint16_t frame_overruns;
    std::uint16_t cmds_accepted;
    std::uint16_t cmds_rejected;
    std::uint16_t events;
    std::uint8_t pool_high_water;
    std::uint16_t tm_dropped;
    std::uint8_t gyro_active;       // the unit id in use
    std::int32_t sensor[kHkSensors];
    std::uint8_t flags;             // bit i: sensor i stuck; bit 4+i: sensor i in red
};

// Counters are 32-bit on board and 16-bit in the report: they stop at
// 65535 instead of wrapping, so a big number never reads as a small one.
std::uint16_t sat16(std::uint32_t v) { return v > 0xFFFFu ? 0xFFFFu : static_cast<std::uint16_t>(v); }
std::uint8_t sat8(std::size_t v) { return v > 0xFFu ? 0xFFu : static_cast<std::uint8_t>(v); }

// The fixed layout, big-endian, in the order the struct lists the fields.
Status hk_serialize(const HkReport& r, std::uint8_t* out, std::size_t cap, std::size_t* n) {
    if (out == nullptr || n == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
    if (cap < kHkBytes) return Status::NoSpace;
    ByteWriter w(out, cap);
    w.u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(r.mode));
    w.u16(r.faults_latched);
    w.u32(r.uptime_s);
    w.u16(r.frame_overruns);
    w.u16(r.cmds_accepted);
    w.u16(r.cmds_rejected);
    w.u16(r.events);
    w.u8(r.pool_high_water);
    w.u16(r.tm_dropped);
    w.u8(r.gyro_active);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kHkSensors; ++i) w.i32(r.sensor[i]);
    w.u8(r.flags);
    if (!w.ok()) return w.status();
    *n = w.size();
    return Status::Ok;
}

// Ground side. BadLength unless exactly kHkBytes; BadArg for a mode byte
// that is not a mode. *out is left alone on failure.
Status hk_parse(const std::uint8_t* in, std::size_t n, HkReport* out) {
    if (in == nullptr || out == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
    if (n != kHkBytes) return Status::BadLength;
    ByteReader r(in, n);
    HkReport h{};
    std::uint8_t mode = 0;
    r.u8(&mode);
    if (mode > 2) return Status::BadArg;
    h.mode = static_cast<Mode>(mode);
    r.u16(&h.faults_latched);
    r.u32(&h.uptime_s);
    r.u16(&h.frame_overruns);
    r.u16(&h.cmds_accepted);
    r.u16(&h.cmds_rejected);
    r.u16(&h.events);
    r.u8(&h.pool_high_water);
    r.u16(&h.tm_dropped);
    r.u8(&h.gyro_active);
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kHkSensors; ++i) r.i32(&h.sensor[i]);
    r.u8(&h.flags);
    if (!r.ok()) return r.status();
    *out = h;
    return Status::Ok;
}

// Three lines for the ground display. Returns what snprintf returns.
int hk_format(const HkReport& r, char* buf, std::size_t cap) {
    if (buf == nullptr) return -1;
    return std::snprintf(buf, cap,
                         "mode=%s uptime=%us faults=0x%04X\n"
                         "cmds ok=%u rejected=%u overruns=%u events=%u pool_hw=%u dropped=%u gyro=%u\n"
                         "sensors %d %d %d %d flags=0x%02X",
                         mode_name(r.mode), static_cast<unsigned>(r.uptime_s), static_cast<unsigned>(r.faults_latched),
                         static_cast<unsigned>(r.cmds_accepted), static_cast<unsigned>(r.cmds_rejected),
                         static_cast<unsigned>(r.frame_overruns), static_cast<unsigned>(r.events),
                         static_cast<unsigned>(r.pool_high_water), static_cast<unsigned>(r.tm_dropped),
                         static_cast<unsigned>(r.gyro_active), static_cast<int>(r.sensor[0]), static_cast<int>(r.sensor[1]),
                         static_cast<int>(r.sensor[2]), static_cast<int>(r.sensor[3]), static_cast<unsigned>(r.flags));
}

// ---- The downlink: two queues, one pool, a byte budget per frame ------------
constexpr std::size_t kDownlinkBytesPerFrame = 300;

class Downlink {
public:
    explicit Downlink(BufferPool* pool) : urgent_(pool), routine_(pool) {}

    // Queues a packet. A packet that cannot be queued is dropped and
    // counted; the status says why.
    Status send(const std::uint8_t* pkt, std::size_t len, bool urgent) {
        const Status s = urgent ? urgent_.put(pkt, len) : routine_.put(pkt, len);
        if (s == Status::Full || s == Status::NoSpace) ++dropped_;
        return s;
    }

    // Writes queued packets into out, each after the sync marker: urgent
    // ones first, oldest first within a queue. Stops before the first
    // packet whose framed size would pass `budget` or `cap` bytes, so a
    // packet is never split. Returns the bytes written.
    std::size_t pump(std::uint8_t* out, std::size_t cap, std::size_t budget) {
        if (out == nullptr) return 0;
        const std::size_t limit = budget < cap ? budget : cap;
        std::size_t used = 0;
        for (std::size_t guard = 0; guard < kBufferCount; ++guard) {
            const bool from_urgent = !urgent_.empty();
            if (!from_urgent && routine_.empty()) break;
            std::size_t len = 0;
            if (from_urgent) urgent_.front_len(&len); else routine_.front_len(&len);
            if (used + kSyncBytes + len > limit) break;
            std::memcpy(out + used, kSyncMarker, kSyncBytes);
            std::size_t got = 0;
            if (from_urgent) urgent_.take(out + used + kSyncBytes, len, &got); else routine_.take(out + used + kSyncBytes, len, &got);
            used += kSyncBytes + got;
            ++sent_;
        }
        return used;
    }

    std::uint32_t sent() const { return sent_; }
    std::uint32_t dropped() const { return dropped_; }
    std::size_t queued() const { return urgent_.size() + routine_.size(); }

private:
    PacketQueue<8> urgent_;
    PacketQueue<16> routine_;
    std::uint32_t sent_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t dropped_ = 0;
};

// ---- The flight system: every part, wired together --------------------------
// The mission's configuration, as the systems engineers wrote it down.
constexpr std::size_t kSensorCount = 4;
constexpr std::uint16_t kUnitBusV = 0;
constexpr std::uint16_t kUnitBattT = 1;
constexpr std::uint16_t kUnitGyroA = 2;
constexpr std::uint16_t kUnitGyroB = 3;
constexpr std::uint16_t kSensorTmApid = 0x021;
constexpr std::uint16_t kScienceApid = 0x030;
constexpr std::uint16_t kStuckWindow = 20;
constexpr std::uint8_t kPersistSet = 5;
constexpr std::uint8_t kPersistClear = 10;
constexpr std::size_t kUplinkDepth = 8;
constexpr std::size_t kCommandsPerFrame = 2;
constexpr std::uint32_t kUplinkErrorLimit = 3;   // bad command packets in one second

const SensorConfig kSensorConfigs[kSensorCount] = {
    {"BUS_V", kUnitBusV, {0, 8, 1}, 3500, 6, 11u},             // mV: 3500 counts is 28.0 V
    {"BATT_T", kUnitBattT, {-50000, 25, 1}, 2800, 4, 22u},     // m°C: 2800 counts is 20.0 °C
    {"GYRO_A", kUnitGyroA, {-20480, 10, 1}, 2048, 3, 33u},     // m°/s: 2048 counts is 0
    {"GYRO_B", kUnitGyroB, {-20480, 10, 1}, 2048, 3, 44u},
};

const Limits kSensorLimits[kSensorCount] = {
    {24000, 26000, 31000, 33000},
    {-5000, 0, 35000, 45000},
    {-5000, -2000, 2000, 5000},
    {-5000, -2000, 2000, 5000},
};

struct TaskPlan {
    const char* name;
    std::uint8_t period;
    std::uint8_t offset;
    std::uint32_t budget_us;
    std::uint32_t cost_us;   // what it normally uses
    bool essential;
};

// Task ids are their places in this table.
constexpr std::uint8_t kTaskSense = 0, kTaskMonitor = 1, kTaskCommand = 2, kTaskDownlink = 3;
constexpr std::uint8_t kTaskScience = 4, kTaskTelemetry = 5, kTaskHk = 6, kTaskFdir = 7;
constexpr std::size_t kTaskCount = 8;

const TaskPlan kTaskPlan[kTaskCount] = {
    {"SENSE", 1, 0, 20000, 12000, true},
    {"MONITOR", 1, 0, 10000, 6000, true},
    {"COMMAND", 1, 0, 10000, 3000, true},
    {"DOWNLINK", 1, 0, 5000, 2000, true},
    {"SCIENCE", 2, 1, 30000, 20000, false},
    {"TELEMETRY", 5, 2, 15000, 8000, false},
    {"HK", 10, 3, 15000, 9000, true},
    {"FDIR", 10, 4, 10000, 4000, true},
};

const FaultRule kFaultRules[kFaultKinds] = {
    {FaultId::SensorStuck, Response::Isolate, 255, Response::SafeMode},
    {FaultId::LimitRed, Response::SafeMode, 0, Response::SafeMode},
    {FaultId::TaskOverrun, Response::Recover, 2, Response::Isolate},
    {FaultId::FrameOverrun, Response::LogOnly, 255, Response::SafeMode},
    {FaultId::UplinkErrors, Response::LogOnly, 255, Response::LogOnly},
};

class FlightSystem {
public:
    FlightSystem() : downlink_(&pool_) {}

    // Start-up: the only time anything is configured. Ends in Nominal mode.
    Status init() {
        if (ready_) return Status::Ok;
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kSensorCount; ++i) {
            Status s = sensors_[i].configure(kSensorConfigs[i]);
            if (s == Status::Ok) s = limits_[i].configure(kSensorLimits[i], kPersistSet, kPersistClear);
            if (s == Status::Ok) s = stuck_[i].configure(kStuckWindow);
            if (s != Status::Ok) return s;
        }
        Status s = gyro_.configure(kUnitGyroA, kUnitGyroB);
        if (s != Status::Ok) return s;
        modes_.attach_log(&log_);
        modes_.listen(&FlightSystem::on_mode, this);
        sched_.attach_log(&log_);
        cmds_.attach(&modes_, &log_);
        faults_.attach(&modes_, &log_, {&FlightSystem::isolate_hook, &FlightSystem::recover_hook, this});
        for (std::size_t k = 0; k < kFaultKinds && s == Status::Ok; ++k) s = faults_.set_rule(kFaultRules[k]);
        if (s != Status::Ok) return s;
        const TaskFn fns[kTaskCount] = {&task_sense, &task_monitor, &task_command, &task_downlink,
                                        &task_science, &task_telemetry, &task_hk, &task_fdir};
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kTaskCount; ++i) {
            const TaskPlan& p = kTaskPlan[i];
            std::uint8_t id = 0;
            s = sched_.add({p.name, fns[i], this, p.period, p.offset, p.budget_us, p.essential}, &id);
            if (s != Status::Ok) return s;
        }
        s = sched_.build();
        if (s != Status::Ok) return s;
        bank_ = {limits_, static_cast<std::uint8_t>(kSensorCount)};
        const CommandDef defs[] = {
            {kOpNoop, "NOOP", 0, true, &cmd_noop, nullptr},
            {kOpSetMode, "SET_MODE", 1, true, &cmd_set_mode, &modes_},
            {kOpResetCounters, "RESET_COUNTERS", 0, true, &cmd_reset_counters, &cmds_},
            {kOpSetLimits, "SET_LIMITS", 17, false, &cmd_set_limits, &bank_},
            {kOpEnableTask, "ENABLE_TASK", 1, false, &cmd_enable_task, &sched_},
            {kOpDisableTask, "DISABLE_TASK", 1, true, &cmd_disable_task, &sched_},
            {kOpClearFault, "CLEAR_FAULT", 1, true, &cmd_clear_fault, &faults_},
            {kOpRestoreSensor, "RESTORE_SENSOR", 1, true, &cmd_restore_sensor, &gyro_},
        };
        for (const CommandDef& d : defs) {
            s = cmds_.add(d);
            if (s != Status::Ok) return s;
        }
        ready_ = true;
        return modes_.request(Mode::Nominal, 0);
    }

    // One minor frame.
    Status step() {
        if (!ready_) return Status::NotReady;
        radio_len_ = 0;
        return sched_.run_frame();
    }

    // Ground to spacecraft: queues a command packet for the COMMAND task.
    Status uplink(const std::uint8_t* bytes, std::size_t len) {
        if (bytes == nullptr || len == 0 || len > kMaxPacketBytes) return Status::BadArg;
        PacketBuffer b{};
        std::memcpy(b.bytes, bytes, len);
        b.len = static_cast<std::uint16_t>(len);
        return uplink_.push(b);
    }

    // The bytes the DOWNLINK task sent during the last frame.
    const std::uint8_t* radio() const { return radio_; }
    std::size_t radio_len() const { return radio_len_; }

    // ---- Fault injection, for testing on the ground ----
    Status inject_sensor(std::uint16_t unit, SensorFault f, std::int32_t param) {
        if (unit >= kSensorCount) return Status::NotFound;
        if (f == SensorFault::None) {
            sensors_[unit].sim().clear_fault();
            return Status::Ok;
        }
        return sensors_[unit].sim().inject(f, param);
    }
    // The task reports `us` microseconds for its next `runs` runs.
    Status inject_overrun(std::uint8_t task, std::uint32_t us, std::uint32_t runs) {
        if (task >= kTaskCount) return Status::NotFound;
        overrun_us_[task] = us;
        overrun_runs_[task] = runs;
        return Status::Ok;
    }
    // The next n packets sent get one bit of their CRC flipped.
    void corrupt_downlink(std::uint32_t n) { corrupt_pending_ = n; }

    HkReport hk() const {
        HkReport r{};
        r.mode = modes_.mode();
        r.faults_latched = faults_.latched();
        r.uptime_s = now_ms() / 1000;
        r.frame_overruns = sat16(sched_.frame_overruns());
        r.cmds_accepted = sat16(cmds_.accepted());
        r.cmds_rejected = sat16(cmds_.rejected());
        r.events = sat16(log_.total());
        r.pool_high_water = sat8(pool_.high_water());
        r.tm_dropped = sat16(downlink_.dropped());
        r.gyro_active = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(gyro_.active());
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kSensorCount; ++i) {
            r.sensor[i] = sensors_[i].filtered();
            if (stuck_[i].stuck()) r.flags = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(r.flags | (1u << i));
            if (is_red(limits_[i].state())) r.flags = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(r.flags | (1u << (4 + i)));
        }
        return r;
    }

    std::uint32_t now_ms() const { return sched_.tick() * (kMinorFrameUs / 1000); }
    const ModeManager& modes() const { return modes_; }
    const Scheduler& sched() const { return sched_; }
    const CommandHandler& cmds() const { return cmds_; }
    const FaultManager& faults() const { return faults_; }
    const EventLog& events() const { return log_; }
    const SensorPair& gyro() const { return gyro_; }
    const SensorChannel& sensor(std::size_t i) const { return sensors_[i < kSensorCount ? i : 0]; }
    const LimitMonitor& limit(std::size_t i) const { return limits_[i < kSensorCount ? i : 0]; }
    const Downlink& downlink() const { return downlink_; }
    std::uint32_t uplink_errors() const { return uplink_errors_; }
    std::uint32_t packets_sent() const { return tm_.packets_built(); }

private:
    // What a task reports: its normal cost, or an injected overrun.
    std::uint32_t cost(std::uint8_t task) {
        if (overrun_runs_[task] > 0) {
            --overrun_runs_[task];
            return overrun_us_[task];
        }
        return kTaskPlan[task].cost_us;
    }

    // Builds a packet and queues it for the downlink.
    void send_tm(std::uint16_t apid, const std::uint8_t* payload, std::size_t len, bool urgent) {
        std::uint8_t pkt[kMaxPacket];
        std::size_t n = 0;
        if (tm_.build(PacketType::Telemetry, apid, now_ms(), payload, len, pkt, sizeof pkt, &n) != Status::Ok) return;
        if (corrupt_pending_ > 0) {
            --corrupt_pending_;
            pkt[n - 1] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(pkt[n - 1] ^ 0x01);
        }
        downlink_.send(pkt, n, urgent);
    }

    static std::uint32_t task_sense(void* ctx, std::uint32_t) {
        FlightSystem* fs = static_cast<FlightSystem*>(ctx);
        for (std::uint16_t i = 0; i < kSensorCount; ++i) {
            fs->sensors_[i].sample(nullptr);
            bool became = false, back = false;
            fs->stuck_[i].update(fs->sensors_[i].last_raw(), &became, &back);
            if (back) fs->log_.record(fs->now_ms(), kEvSensorUnstuck, i, fs->sensors_[i].last_raw());
            if (became) {
                fs->log_.record(fs->now_ms(), kEvSensorStuck, i, fs->sensors_[i].last_raw());
                Response r;
                fs->faults_.report(FaultId::SensorStuck, i, fs->now_ms(), &r);
            }
        }
        return fs->cost(kTaskSense);
    }

    static std::uint32_t task_monitor(void* ctx, std::uint32_t) {
        FlightSystem* fs = static_cast<FlightSystem*>(ctx);
        const std::uint16_t watched[3] = {kUnitBusV, kUnitBattT, fs->gyro_.active()};
        for (std::uint16_t unit : watched) {
            bool changed = false;
            const std::int32_t v = fs->sensors_[unit].filtered();
            fs->limits_[unit].update(v, &changed);
            if (!changed) continue;
            const LimitState st = fs->limits_[unit].state();
            const std::uint16_t ev = st == LimitState::Nominal ? kEvLimitNominal : (is_red(st) ? kEvLimitRed : kEvLimitYellow);
            fs->log_.record(fs->now_ms(), ev, unit, v);
            if (is_red(st)) {
                Response r;
                fs->faults_.report(FaultId::LimitRed, unit, fs->now_ms(), &r);
            }
        }
        return fs->cost(kTaskMonitor);
    }

    static std::uint32_t task_command(void* ctx, std::uint32_t) {
        FlightSystem* fs = static_cast<FlightSystem*>(ctx);
        std::uint32_t extra = 0;
        for (std::size_t k = 0; k < kCommandsPerFrame; ++k) {
            PacketBuffer b;
            if (fs->uplink_.pop(&b) != Status::Ok) break;
            Ack ack;
            const Status s = fs->cmds_.handle(b.bytes, b.len, fs->now_ms(), &ack);
            if (s == Status::TooShort || s == Status::BadVersion || s == Status::BadType ||
                s == Status::BadLength || s == Status::BadCrc) {
                ++fs->uplink_errors_;
            }
            std::uint8_t pkt[kMaxPacket];
            std::size_t n = 0;
            if (encode_ack(ack, &fs->tm_, fs->now_ms(), pkt, sizeof pkt, &n) == Status::Ok) {
                if (fs->corrupt_pending_ > 0) {
                    --fs->corrupt_pending_;
                    pkt[n - 1] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(pkt[n - 1] ^ 0x01);
                }
                fs->downlink_.send(pkt, n, true);
            }
            extra += 1000;
        }
        return fs->cost(kTaskCommand) + extra;
    }

    static std::uint32_t task_downlink(void* ctx, std::uint32_t) {
        FlightSystem* fs = static_cast<FlightSystem*>(ctx);
        fs->radio_len_ = fs->downlink_.pump(fs->radio_, sizeof fs->radio_, kDownlinkBytesPerFrame);
        return fs->cost(kTaskDownlink);
    }

    // Science: the four filtered values, big-endian int32.
    static std::uint32_t task_science(void* ctx, std::uint32_t) {
        FlightSystem* fs = static_cast<FlightSystem*>(ctx);
        std::uint8_t payload[16];
        ByteWriter w(payload, sizeof payload);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kSensorCount; ++i) w.i32(fs->sensors_[i].filtered());
        fs->send_tm(kScienceApid, payload, w.size(), false);
        return fs->cost(kTaskScience);
    }

    // Sensor telemetry: each sensor's raw count (2 bytes) and limit state (1 byte).
    static std::uint32_t task_telemetry(void* ctx, std::uint32_t) {
        FlightSystem* fs = static_cast<FlightSystem*>(ctx);
        std::uint8_t payload[12];
        ByteWriter w(payload, sizeof payload);
        for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kSensorCount; ++i) {
            w.u16(fs->sensors_[i].last_raw());
            w.u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(fs->limits_[i].state()));
        }
        fs->send_tm(kSensorTmApid, payload, w.size(), false);
        return fs->cost(kTaskTelemetry);
    }

    static std::uint32_t task_hk(void* ctx, std::uint32_t) {
        FlightSystem* fs = static_cast<FlightSystem*>(ctx);
        std::uint8_t payload[kHkBytes];
        std::size_t n = 0;
        if (hk_serialize(fs->hk(), payload, sizeof payload, &n) == Status::Ok) fs->send_tm(kHkApid, payload, n, false);
        return fs->cost(kTaskHk);
    }

    // Once a second: turn counters that grew into faults.
    static std::uint32_t task_fdir(void* ctx, std::uint32_t) {
        FlightSystem* fs = static_cast<FlightSystem*>(ctx);
        Response r;
        const std::uint32_t overruns = fs->sched_.frame_overruns();
        if (overruns != fs->seen_frame_overruns_) {
            fs->seen_frame_overruns_ = overruns;
            fs->faults_.report(FaultId::FrameOverrun, 0, fs->now_ms(), &r);
        }
        for (std::uint8_t id = 0; id < kTaskCount; ++id) {
            const std::uint32_t n = fs->sched_.stats(id)->budget_overruns;
            if (n != fs->seen_task_overruns_[id]) {
                fs->seen_task_overruns_[id] = n;
                fs->faults_.report(FaultId::TaskOverrun, id, fs->now_ms(), &r);
            }
        }
        if (fs->uplink_errors_ - fs->seen_uplink_errors_ >= kUplinkErrorLimit) {
            fs->faults_.report(FaultId::UplinkErrors, 0, fs->now_ms(), &r);
        }
        fs->seen_uplink_errors_ = fs->uplink_errors_;
        return fs->cost(kTaskFdir);
    }

    // Isolation: a stuck gyro hands over to its partner; an overrunning
    // task that is not essential is switched off. Anything else cannot be
    // isolated, and the fault manager escalates.
    static Status isolate_hook(void* ctx, FaultId id, std::uint16_t unit) {
        FlightSystem* fs = static_cast<FlightSystem*>(ctx);
        if (id == FaultId::SensorStuck) {
            if (unit != kUnitGyroA && unit != kUnitGyroB) return Status::NotFound;
            return fs->gyro_.isolate(unit);
        }
        if (id == FaultId::TaskOverrun) {
            if (unit >= kTaskCount || kTaskPlan[unit].essential) return Status::Forbidden;
            fs->task_isolated_[unit] = true;
            return fs->sched_.set_enabled(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(unit), false);
        }
        return Status::NotImpl;
    }

    // Recovery: restarting a task clears whatever made it overrun.
    static Status recover_hook(void* ctx, FaultId id, std::uint16_t unit) {
        FlightSystem* fs = static_cast<FlightSystem*>(ctx);
        if (id != FaultId::TaskOverrun || unit >= kTaskCount) return Status::NotImpl;
        fs->overrun_runs_[unit] = 0;
        return Status::Ok;
    }

    // Safe mode sheds the tasks that are not essential; leaving it brings
    // them back, except the ones fault management switched off.
    static void on_mode(void* ctx, Mode, Mode to) {
        FlightSystem* fs = static_cast<FlightSystem*>(ctx);
        if (to == Mode::Safe) {
            fs->sched_.shed_nonessential();
            return;
        }
        fs->sched_.enable_all();
        for (std::uint8_t id = 0; id < kTaskCount; ++id) {
            if (fs->task_isolated_[id]) fs->sched_.set_enabled(id, false);
        }
    }

    EventLog log_;
    ModeManager modes_;
    Scheduler sched_;
    CommandHandler cmds_;
    FaultManager faults_;
    SensorChannel sensors_[kSensorCount];
    LimitMonitor limits_[kSensorCount];
    StuckMonitor stuck_[kSensorCount];
    SensorPair gyro_;
    MonitorBank bank_ = {nullptr, 0};
    BufferPool pool_;
    Downlink downlink_;
    PacketEncoder tm_;
    RingBuffer<PacketBuffer, kUplinkDepth> uplink_;
    std::uint8_t radio_[kDownlinkBytesPerFrame] = {};
    std::size_t radio_len_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t overrun_us_[kTaskCount] = {};
    std::uint32_t overrun_runs_[kTaskCount] = {};
    bool task_isolated_[kTaskCount] = {};
    std::uint32_t corrupt_pending_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t uplink_errors_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t seen_frame_overruns_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t seen_task_overruns_[kTaskCount] = {};
    std::uint32_t seen_uplink_errors_ = 0;
    bool ready_ = false;
};

// ---- The ground station -----------------------------------------------------
class GroundStation {
public:
    // Everything the spacecraft sent in one frame.
    void receive(const std::uint8_t* bytes, std::size_t n) {
        if (bytes == nullptr || n == 0) return;
        rx_.feed(bytes, n);
        Packet p;
        for (std::size_t guard = 0; guard < kStreamBufferBytes; ++guard) {
            if (rx_.next(&p) != Status::Ok) break;
            std::uint16_t missed = 0;
            seq_.observe(p.hdr.apid, p.hdr.seq_count, &missed);
            if (p.hdr.apid == kHkApid && hk_parse(p.payload, p.payload_len, &last_hk_) == Status::Ok) ++hk_count_;
            if (p.hdr.apid == kAckApid && p.payload_len == 4) {
                if (p.payload[3] == static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Status::Ok)) ++acks_; else ++naks_;
            }
        }
    }

    // Sends a command. With garble, one bit of its CRC is flipped on the way.
    Status command(FlightSystem* fs, std::uint8_t opcode, const std::uint8_t* args, std::size_t n, bool garble) {
        if (fs == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
        std::uint8_t pkt[kMaxPacket];
        std::size_t len = 0;
        const Status s = build_command(next_seq_, opcode, args, n, fs->now_ms(), pkt, sizeof pkt, &len);
        if (s != Status::Ok) return s;
        next_seq_ = static_cast<std::uint16_t>((next_seq_ + 1) & kSeqMask);
        if (garble) pkt[len - 1] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(pkt[len - 1] ^ 0x01);
        return fs->uplink(pkt, len);
    }

    const StreamDecoder& rx() const { return rx_; }
    const SequenceTracker& seq() const { return seq_; }
    const HkReport& last_hk() const { return last_hk_; }
    std::uint32_t hk_count() const { return hk_count_; }
    std::uint32_t acks() const { return acks_; }
    std::uint32_t naks() const { return naks_; }

private:
    StreamDecoder rx_;
    SequenceTracker seq_;
    HkReport last_hk_ = {};
    std::uint32_t hk_count_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t acks_ = 0;
    std::uint32_t naks_ = 0;
    std::uint16_t next_seq_ = 0;
};

// ---- The ground's dictionary: ids and numbers turned into words -------------
const char* fault_name(std::uint16_t id) {
    static const char* const names[kFaultKinds] = {"SENSOR_STUCK", "LIMIT_RED", "TASK_OVERRUN", "FRAME_OVERRUN", "UPLINK_ERRORS"};
    return id < kFaultKinds ? names[id] : "?";
}

const char* unit_name(std::uint16_t unit) { return unit < kSensorCount ? kSensorConfigs[unit].name : "?"; }
const char* task_label(std::uint16_t id) { return id < kTaskCount ? kTaskPlan[id].name : "?"; }

const char* opcode_name(std::uint16_t op) {
    switch (op) {
        case 0: return "-";   // the command never got as far as its opcode
        case kOpNoop: return "NOOP";
        case kOpSetMode: return "SET_MODE";
        case kOpResetCounters: return "RESET_COUNTERS";
        case kOpSetLimits: return "SET_LIMITS";
        case kOpEnableTask: return "ENABLE_TASK";
        case kOpDisableTask: return "DISABLE_TASK";
        case kOpClearFault: return "CLEAR_FAULT";
        case kOpRestoreSensor: return "RESTORE_SENSOR";
    }
    return "?";
}

const char* status_of(std::int32_t v) { return v >= 0 && v <= static_cast<std::int32_t>(Status::Overrun) ? status_name(static_cast<Status>(v)) : "?"; }
const char* mode_of(std::int32_t v) { return v >= 0 && v <= 2 ? mode_name(static_cast<Mode>(v)) : "?"; }
const char* response_of(std::int32_t v) { return v >= 0 && v <= 3 ? response_name(static_cast<Response>(v)) : "?"; }

// One event as one line, for example "t=612.3 SENSOR_STUCK GYRO_A raw=2047".
int format_event(const Event& e, char* buf, std::size_t cap) {
    if (buf == nullptr) return -1;
    const unsigned sec = e.time_ms / 1000;
    const unsigned tenth = (e.time_ms % 1000) / 100;
    char what[80];
    switch (e.id) {
        case kEvLimitNominal: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "LIMIT_NOMINAL %s value=%d", unit_name(e.source), static_cast<int>(e.value)); break;
        case kEvLimitYellow: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "LIMIT_YELLOW %s value=%d", unit_name(e.source), static_cast<int>(e.value)); break;
        case kEvLimitRed: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "LIMIT_RED %s value=%d", unit_name(e.source), static_cast<int>(e.value)); break;
        case kEvSensorStuck: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "SENSOR_STUCK %s raw=%d", unit_name(e.source), static_cast<int>(e.value)); break;
        case kEvSensorUnstuck: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "SENSOR_UNSTUCK %s raw=%d", unit_name(e.source), static_cast<int>(e.value)); break;
        case kEvFrameOverrun: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "FRAME_OVERRUN used_us=%d", static_cast<int>(e.value)); break;
        case kEvTaskOverrun: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "TASK_OVERRUN %s used_us=%d", task_label(e.source), static_cast<int>(e.value)); break;
        case kEvTaskSkipped: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "TASK_SKIPPED %s", task_label(e.source)); break;
        case kEvModeChange: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "MODE %s -> %s", mode_of(e.source), mode_of(e.value)); break;
        case kEvCmdAccepted: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "CMD_OK %s", opcode_name(e.source)); break;
        case kEvCmdRejected: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "CMD_REJECTED %s %s", opcode_name(e.source), status_of(e.value)); break;
        case kEvCmdFailed: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "CMD_FAILED %s %s", opcode_name(e.source), status_of(e.value)); break;
        case kEvFault: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "FAULT %s unit=%d", fault_name(e.source), static_cast<int>(e.value)); break;
        case kEvResponse: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "RESPONSE %s %s", fault_name(e.source), response_of(e.value)); break;
        case kEvEscalated: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "ESCALATED %s %s failed", fault_name(e.source), response_of(e.value)); break;
        default: std::snprintf(what, sizeof what, "EVENT 0x%04X source=%u value=%d", static_cast<unsigned>(e.id), static_cast<unsigned>(e.source), static_cast<int>(e.value)); break;
    }
    return std::snprintf(buf, cap, "t=%u.%u %s", sec, tenth, what);
}

// ---- Scenarios: faults and commands at given seconds, read from text --------
//   <second> stuck|dead|clear <SENSOR>
//   <second> bias <SENSOR> <counts>        <second> spike <SENSOR> <samples>
//   <second> overrun <TASK> <us> <runs>
//   <second> corrupt <n>                   the next n downlinked packets
//   <second> garble <n>                    the next n commands sent
//   <second> cmd NOOP | RESET_COUNTERS
//   <second> cmd SET_MODE NOMINAL|SAFE
//   <second> cmd ENABLE_TASK|DISABLE_TASK <TASK>
//   <second> cmd CLEAR_FAULT <fault number>
//   <second> cmd RESTORE_SENSOR <SENSOR>
//   <second> cmd SET_LIMITS <SENSOR> <red_low> <yellow_low> <yellow_high> <red_high>
// Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. Seconds run from 0 to
// 3599 and never go down from one line to the next.
constexpr std::size_t kMaxInjections = 64;
constexpr std::uint32_t kHourSeconds = 3600;

enum class Action : std::uint8_t { Sensor, Overrun, Corrupt, Garble, Command };

struct Injection {
    std::uint32_t second;
    Action action;
    std::uint8_t target;      // sensor unit, task id or opcode
    SensorFault fault;
    std::int32_t a;           // the numbers after the names
    std::int32_t b;
    std::uint8_t args[17];
    std::uint8_t nargs;
};

struct Scenario {
    Injection items[kMaxInjections];
    std::size_t count;
};

// Looks a name up in a table of names; -1 if it is not there.
int find_name(const char* word, const char* const* names, std::size_t n) {
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (std::strcmp(word, names[i]) == 0) return static_cast<int>(i);
    }
    return -1;
}

bool parse_int(const char* word, std::int32_t* out) {
    if (word == nullptr || *word == '\0') return false;
    char* end = nullptr;
    const long long v = std::strtoll(word, &end, 10);
    if (*end != '\0' || v < INT32_MIN || v > INT32_MAX) return false;
    *out = static_cast<std::int32_t>(v);
    return true;
}

// Parses one line into *inj. The line is cut into words in place.
Status parse_line(char* line, Injection* inj) {
    char* w[8] = {};
    std::size_t n = 0;
    for (char* tok = std::strtok(line, " \t\r"); tok != nullptr && n < 8; tok = std::strtok(nullptr, " \t\r")) w[n++] = tok;
    if (n < 2) return Status::BadArg;
    std::int32_t sec = 0;
    if (!parse_int(w[0], &sec) || sec < 0 || sec >= static_cast<std::int32_t>(kHourSeconds)) return Status::BadArg;
    *inj = Injection{};
    inj->second = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(sec);
    const char* sensors[kSensorCount] = {kSensorConfigs[0].name, kSensorConfigs[1].name, kSensorConfigs[2].name, kSensorConfigs[3].name};
    const char* tasks[kTaskCount];
    for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kTaskCount; ++i) tasks[i] = kTaskPlan[i].name;
    const char* verb = w[1];
    if (std::strcmp(verb, "stuck") == 0 || std::strcmp(verb, "dead") == 0 || std::strcmp(verb, "clear") == 0 ||
        std::strcmp(verb, "bias") == 0 || std::strcmp(verb, "spike") == 0) {
        const bool numbered = verb[0] == 'b' || verb[1] == 'p';
        if (n != (numbered ? 4u : 3u)) return Status::BadArg;
        const int unit = find_name(w[2], sensors, kSensorCount);
        if (unit < 0) return Status::BadArg;
        inj->action = Action::Sensor;
        inj->target = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(unit);
        inj->fault = verb[0] == 's' ? (verb[1] == 't' ? SensorFault::Stuck : SensorFault::Spike)
                   : verb[0] == 'd' ? SensorFault::Dead : verb[0] == 'b' ? SensorFault::Bias : SensorFault::None;
        if (numbered && !parse_int(w[3], &inj->a)) return Status::BadArg;
        if (inj->fault == SensorFault::Spike && inj->a <= 0) return Status::BadArg;
        return Status::Ok;
    }
    if (std::strcmp(verb, "overrun") == 0) {
        if (n != 5) return Status::BadArg;
        const int task = find_name(w[2], tasks, kTaskCount);
        if (task < 0 || !parse_int(w[3], &inj->a) || !parse_int(w[4], &inj->b) || inj->a < 0 || inj->b < 0) return Status::BadArg;
        inj->action = Action::Overrun;
        inj->target = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(task);
        return Status::Ok;
    }
    if (std::strcmp(verb, "corrupt") == 0 || std::strcmp(verb, "garble") == 0) {
        if (n != 3 || !parse_int(w[2], &inj->a) || inj->a < 0) return Status::BadArg;
        inj->action = verb[0] == 'c' ? Action::Corrupt : Action::Garble;
        return Status::Ok;
    }
    if (std::strcmp(verb, "cmd") != 0 || n < 3) return Status::BadArg;
    inj->action = Action::Command;
    const char* name = w[2];
    if (std::strcmp(name, "NOOP") == 0 || std::strcmp(name, "RESET_COUNTERS") == 0) {
        if (n != 3) return Status::BadArg;
        inj->target = name[0] == 'N' ? kOpNoop : kOpResetCounters;
        return Status::Ok;
    }
    if (std::strcmp(name, "SET_MODE") == 0) {
        if (n != 4) return Status::BadArg;
        inj->target = kOpSetMode;
        if (std::strcmp(w[3], "NOMINAL") == 0) inj->args[0] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Mode::Nominal);
        else if (std::strcmp(w[3], "SAFE") == 0) inj->args[0] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(Mode::Safe);
        else return Status::BadArg;
        inj->nargs = 1;
        return Status::Ok;
    }
    if (std::strcmp(name, "ENABLE_TASK") == 0 || std::strcmp(name, "DISABLE_TASK") == 0) {
        if (n != 4) return Status::BadArg;
        const int task = find_name(w[3], tasks, kTaskCount);
        if (task < 0) return Status::BadArg;
        inj->target = name[0] == 'E' ? kOpEnableTask : kOpDisableTask;
        inj->args[0] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(task);
        inj->nargs = 1;
        return Status::Ok;
    }
    if (std::strcmp(name, "CLEAR_FAULT") == 0) {
        std::int32_t id = 0;
        if (n != 4 || !parse_int(w[3], &id) || id < 0 || id > 255) return Status::BadArg;
        inj->target = kOpClearFault;
        inj->args[0] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(id);
        inj->nargs = 1;
        return Status::Ok;
    }
    if (std::strcmp(name, "RESTORE_SENSOR") == 0) {
        if (n != 4) return Status::BadArg;
        const int unit = find_name(w[3], sensors, kSensorCount);
        if (unit < 0) return Status::BadArg;
        inj->target = kOpRestoreSensor;
        inj->args[0] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(unit);
        inj->nargs = 1;
        return Status::Ok;
    }
    if (std::strcmp(name, "SET_LIMITS") == 0) {
        if (n != 8) return Status::BadArg;
        const int unit = find_name(w[3], sensors, kSensorCount);
        if (unit < 0) return Status::BadArg;
        ByteWriter bw(inj->args, sizeof inj->args);
        bw.u8(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(unit));
        for (std::size_t k = 4; k < 8; ++k) {
            std::int32_t v = 0;
            if (!parse_int(w[k], &v)) return Status::BadArg;
            bw.i32(v);
        }
        inj->target = kOpSetLimits;
        inj->nargs = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(bw.size());
        return Status::Ok;
    }
    return Status::BadArg;
}

// Parses a whole scenario. On failure *bad_line is the line number (from 1).
Status parse_scenario(const char* text, Scenario* sc, std::size_t* bad_line) {
    if (text == nullptr || sc == nullptr || bad_line == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
    sc->count = 0;
    *bad_line = 0;
    char line[160];
    std::size_t line_no = 0;
    const char* p = text;
    while (*p != '\0') {
        ++line_no;
        std::size_t len = 0;
        while (p[len] != '\0' && p[len] != '\n') ++len;
        const bool too_long = len >= sizeof line;
        if (!too_long) {
            std::memcpy(line, p, len);
            line[len] = '\0';
        }
        p += len;
        if (*p == '\n') ++p;
        if (too_long) {
            *bad_line = line_no;
            return Status::BadArg;
        }
        std::size_t first = 0;
        while (line[first] == ' ' || line[first] == '\t' || line[first] == '\r') ++first;
        if (line[first] == '\0' || line[first] == '#') continue;
        if (sc->count == kMaxInjections) {
            *bad_line = line_no;
            return Status::Full;
        }
        Injection& inj = sc->items[sc->count];
        if (parse_line(line + first, &inj) != Status::Ok ||
            (sc->count > 0 && inj.second < sc->items[sc->count - 1].second)) {
            *bad_line = line_no;
            return Status::BadArg;
        }
        ++sc->count;
    }
    return Status::Ok;
}

// ---- One hour of flight -------------------------------------------------------
void apply(const Injection& inj, FlightSystem* fs, GroundStation* gs, std::uint32_t* garble_left) {
    switch (inj.action) {
        case Action::Sensor: fs->inject_sensor(inj.target, inj.fault, inj.a); break;
        case Action::Overrun: fs->inject_overrun(inj.target, static_cast<std::uint32_t>(inj.a), static_cast<std::uint32_t>(inj.b)); break;
        case Action::Corrupt: fs->corrupt_downlink(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(inj.a)); break;
        case Action::Garble: *garble_left = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(inj.a); break;
        case Action::Command: {
            const bool garble = *garble_left > 0;
            if (garble) --*garble_left;
            gs->command(fs, inj.target, inj.args, inj.nargs, garble);
            break;
        }
    }
}

// Runs 36,000 minor frames. Injections for second s are applied just
// before frame 10*s. After each frame the ground receives the radio bytes
// and every new event is printed to out (unless out is null).
Status run_hour(const Scenario& sc, FlightSystem* fs, GroundStation* gs, std::FILE* out) {
    if (fs == nullptr || gs == nullptr) return Status::BadArg;
    const Status s = fs->init();
    if (s != Status::Ok) return s;
    std::size_t next = 0;
    std::uint32_t garble_left = 0;
    std::uint32_t printed = 0;
    const std::uint32_t frames = kHourSeconds * kFramesPerMajor;
    for (std::uint32_t tick = 0; tick < frames; ++tick) {
        while (next < sc.count && sc.items[next].second * kFramesPerMajor == tick) apply(sc.items[next++], fs, gs, &garble_left);
        fs->step();
        gs->receive(fs->radio(), fs->radio_len());
        const EventLog& log = fs->events();
        if (out != nullptr) {
            const std::uint32_t fresh = log.total() - printed;
            for (std::uint32_t k = fresh; k > 0; --k) {
                Event e;
                if (k > log.size() || log.at(log.size() - k, &e) != Status::Ok) continue;
                char line[128];
                format_event(e, line, sizeof line);
                std::fprintf(out, "%s\n", line);
            }
        }
        printed = log.total();
    }
    return Status::Ok;
}

void print_summary(const FlightSystem& fs, const GroundStation& gs, long long heap_used, std::FILE* out) {
    char buf[320];
    hk_format(fs.hk(), buf, sizeof buf);
